name: wv-connectors
description: Default Gemini Enterprise (GE) federated connector bridge for State of West Virginia cohorts using Azure/Entra-synced Google Identity—unlocking Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Gmail, Drive, GitHub, and BigQuery with zero laptop installs.
suggestedPrompts: Run /connect-ge to link my West Virginia Gemini Enterprise instance and test my federated connectors

Show me how to query Teams threads, GitHub issues, or BigQuery datasets safely from Antigravity
